summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit presenting earnings coverage ratios for subordinated indebtedness and preferred shares for the twelve months ended July 31, 2026, as required under Canadian securities rules for shelf distributions. The filing includes coverage ratios (interest coverage 45.13, dividend coverage 19.88) and fixed charge ratios, with no transactional event disclosed. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation.
